description: Two dancers trade places, one rolling across in front of the other.

walkthrough.line: Take near hands with {who}: {roller} rolls across in front, turning in toward them.
walkthrough.teach: Take near hands with {who}. Then {roller} rolls across in front of the other, turning in toward them so the two of you go nose to nose first, and coming all the way round on the way; the other slides sideways into the place they came from. You have traded places and you both still face the way you were.

call.4: ROLL AWAY WITH A HALF SASHAY
